scientific_integrity: The universal bound follows from an exact four-report normalization, three nonnegative piecewise-polynomial identities and a sharp common witness. The standalone verifier provides exact-rational finite checks, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only four agents on a continuous geodesic circle and fixed report-independent convex mixtures of RD and EPCD. Does not establish optimal strategyproof mechanisms or other population sizes. Unindexed equivalent prior art remains possible; independent review not performed.
title: Exact four-agent mixing law for circle-distance facility mechanisms
